name: Morrow
description: An independent image studio with a scrollable profile rail, an asymmetric photographic work wall, and three complete project pages.
tagline: Images with a point of view.

notes.layout: independently scrollable information rail, tall portrait beside two landscape studies, dedicated project pages
notes.motion: subtle image hover, focus reveal, reduced-motion support
notes.interaction: filter three project categories, switch persistent theme, explore project pages, prepare and download a local inquiry brief
notes.provenance: Coded adaptation of Kima’s split portfolio principle, with original code, identity, content, and three generated images. Four HTML pages; not a Framer-native remix.
